# v0.19.0: Prok Market launch prices (launch contract 2026-09-26, §10.3) and the state texts.
#
# Both halves read this file. The server (server/brain/market.py DEFAULT_PRICES, version 1 of
# the dated price table) and the phone (core/MarketView.kt PRICES) must equal it exactly; a
# test on each side holds that line. A price change is a NEW dated version on the server,
# never an edit here without the corresponding tests.
#
# Price lines:   KEY|centimes|duration_days|k=v;k=v   (100 FCFA = 10000 centimes)
# Text lines:    INVOICE_STATE|STATE|text   and   LISTING_STATE|STATE|text
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

POST|10000|30|photos=5
BOOST|20000|7|zones=1
PACKAGE5|40000|90|slots=5
STOREFRONT|200000|30|catalog=1;slots=30
VOUCHER|0|30|face_value=10000;limit=100

INVOICE_STATE|OPEN|En attente de confirmation
INVOICE_STATE|PAID|Payé
INVOICE_STATE|EXPIRED|Expiré
INVOICE_STATE|CANCELLED|Annulé
INVOICE_STATE|REFUND_REQUESTED|Remboursement en cours
INVOICE_STATE|REFUNDED|Remboursé

LISTING_STATE|DRAFT|Brouillon
LISTING_STATE|AWAITING_PAYMENT|En attente de paiement
LISTING_STATE|AWAITING_REVIEW|En attente de modération
LISTING_STATE|PUBLISHED|Publiée
LISTING_STATE|REJECTED|Refusée
LISTING_STATE|EXPIRED|Expirée
LISTING_STATE|WITHDRAWN|Retirée
LISTING_STATE|HIDDEN|Masquée
